name: UDL 3.0
authority: CAST — Universal Design for Learning Guidelines, version 3.0
officialDisclaimer: UDL 3.0 is CAST's framework. Language Bridge applies it as a design requirement, not as a badge or a Texas Education Agency requirement.

representation.language-support.en: Clarify vocabulary and provide home-language support.
representation.language-support.es: Aclarar el vocabulario y ofrecer apoyo en el idioma del hogar.

representation.context.en: Supply context and illustrate through multiple media.
representation.context.es: Ofrecer contexto e ilustrar con varios medios.

action-expression.multiple-response-mode.en: Allow more than one way to respond.
action-expression.multiple-response-mode.es: Permitir más de una forma de responder.

engagement.relevance.en: Make the task authentic and relevant to the learner.
engagement.relevance.es: Hacer que la tarea sea auténtica y relevante para el estudiante.
